text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I gave it everything...!! Even here at 
the Oka Sho... All of my strength...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Alright...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Dober's Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Mejiro Dober--!! Good 
luck in the Oaks too--!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool~!! I'm definitely going 
to watch the Oaks too, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I became a fan after seeing you run 
today...! Make my heart race again, 
pleeease!! I'll be watching you 
foreverrr!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The venue is filled with cheers for the 
Mejiro family's rising star, Mejiro Dober, 
after her magnificent run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...This level of passion... truly 
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"However, this pressure is uncharted 
territory for her... What will happen—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Everyone is looking at me—)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Number 8, Mejiro Dober, is now rounding 
the final corner!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She fell at the start and fell far behind, 
but she's giving it her all without giving 
up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (No... this feeling is—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
There, there, good job! Keep it up until 
the very end!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, just a little further~! 
Everyone's watching you~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (—No, no, no, no!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Why am I remembering that time now!? It's 
completely different!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I ran properly today! I got a great 
result! So why—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's voices, voices, voices, 
voices, voices, people's eyes, eyes, eyes, 
eyes, eyes――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do I... have to keep running through this 
the whole time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: In a place... like this, ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, ...Uuuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(No. No, no, nononono!! I swore it! I 
promised Bright!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I shouldn't be... shaking like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I go to greet Mejiro Dober after her 
magnificent run, but something seems off. 
Her body is trembling slightly, and she 
looks a bit pale…….

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's okay. Please, don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem at all...! I can run in 
the Oaks just fine...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be able to run properly in the Oaks 
too. So please, truly, don't worry about 
me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Otherwise... I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I'm going to be just 
fine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an intensity that seemed as if she 
were compelling herself, Mejiro Dober 
bolted away before I could say a single 
word...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A few days after the Oka Sho, as training 
for the Oaks was underway—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober pushed herself, but something 
was clearly amiss...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a shadow over her expression, and 
in her desperate struggle to shake 
something off, she looks somehow... as if 
she is spinning her wheels.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Pardon the intrusion during your 
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober's Trainer. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...It's probably been since the Oka Sho. 
That Dober became the way she is now."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The cause... or rather, I have a good idea 
of what Dober is currently facing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Taking that into consideration, I'd like 
to ask a favor, fully aware of how 
impolite it is."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Could I speak with Dober for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I intend to make Dober realize it. 
The true nature of what she's carrying 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, this is strictly a matter between 
Dober and her Trainer. If you don't need 
it, feel free to give it back.
choice_data_list: ...I'd like to ask you as well.

...I would like to ask this of you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know something must have happened at the 
Oka Sho. Yet I just don't know what words 
I should say to her right now...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to support her with my own strength 
if I can. However, if I truly want what's 
best for her, right now I must—
choice_data_list: I'd like you to talk with Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you for listening to my 
request.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...The frustration packed into that fist. 
Your feelings for her. I promise you, I 
will not let them go unanswered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Air Groove pointed it out, I realized 
for the first time that I had been 
clenching my fists tightly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There aren't many days left until the 
Oaks. Right now, all I could do was 
earnestly pray for Mejiro Dober's 
recovery."
